SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_303A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7So, let's pick it up and take out
those damn guns.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_303A_ROEB_SAFE.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7So, let's pick it up and take out
those guns.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_500A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Arrangements are being made
to take his body back to the states.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_501A_POLO.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7I thought Sullivan would make
it through for sure.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_502A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We let our guard down, Polonsky.
We can't let it happen again.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_503A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Tojo's got a tight hold on pretty much
everything to the west.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_504A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^75th and 7th Marines are about
to launch their assault on the airfield...

SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_801A_USR1.en: ^1US MARINE: ^7Get a bazooka from the trenches!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_000A_ROOK.en:
^1US MARINE: ^7Confirmed, Sir.
AA guns knocked out.
Skies clear all the way to Bloody Nose Ridge.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_001A_POLO_A.en: ^1POLONSKY: ^7Aww shit... Sarge, we got a problem.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_002A_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Sir, Japanese reinforcements
coming in north of the airfield...

SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_006B_ROEB.en:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Stay strong.
We are holding this airfield!

SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_008A_ROOK.en:
^1US MARINE: ^7Yes, sir. The airfield has been held...
Repeat, the airfield has been held.

SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_205A_POLO.en:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Where the hell did all those
reinforcements come from?!!!

SUBTITLE_RU_1_ORDER_ATTACK_INFANTRY_05.en: ^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7We have them on the run!

SUBTITLE_RU_REZ_THREAT_INFANTRY_EXPOSED_.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7This is what you came here for!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_000A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7See how things have changed, my friend?

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_001A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Now it is their land... Their people...
Their blood.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_003A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Yes, Chernov... But that will not save them.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_007A_CHER.en: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Are we to shoot them in the back?

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_008A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7The back.  The front.  The head!...
Wherever you wish! Just so long as they are dead!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_009A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Hunt them down like the rats they are.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_012A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7After Stalingrad, I know to trust
your instincts, Dimitri.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_013A_REZN_B.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Left or right?... You lead the way.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_015A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Let their burning country be the last
thing they see!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_019A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Throw some Molotovs.
Let them burn in their posts.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_019B_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Use your Molotovs.
Let them burn in their posts.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_022A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Our tanks are moving into the fields!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_029A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7More Panzershreck fire! Take them all out!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_037A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri, I see time has not weakened your aim!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_041A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Their armor is no match for you!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_043A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Stay back! Let our armor deal it!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_045A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Follow me! We will regroup at the barn!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_046A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7There... We will prepare for the final
push to the train station.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_050A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7You could learn much from this man, Chernov...

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_051A_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7Sergeant Reznov,
you seem to relish in the slaughter.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_052A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7I have seen friends and neighbors
die at the hands of this vermin.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_052B_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7I have seen my friends die
in front me at the hands of this vermin.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_053A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7They deserve everything they get...
and more.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_054A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Enough talk.
We must push forward to the train station!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_057A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7When we clear this compound
we can revel in a great victory.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_104A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7As our planes lay waste this land,
we will deal with its animals on the ground!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_105A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri...
Flank the MG before it cuts us all down!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_107A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7I told you Chernov! There will be no escape!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_109A_CHER.en: ^1CHERNOV: ^7How? Our rifles are no match for their armor?

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_117A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Keep going until the last one burns!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_123A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7The cowards may hide in shadows,
but we will find them!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_124A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri, ride on one of the tanks.
You have earned the rest.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_126A_RUR1.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7No room, Comrade.
Try the tank behind.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_127A_RUR1.en: ^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Are you blind?  There is no space.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_128B_CHER.en: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Germans in the field to the left!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_129A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7HA! They scatter like cockroaches in the light!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_131A_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7The path is blocked...
Our tanks cannot move up.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_139A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri!  Blow it to pieces
before they take positions!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_140A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7You may be the Red army's greatest asset!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_143A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7If you are out of rockets,
then put a bullet in the gunner's head!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_145A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7It matters not where they choose to die!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_148A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7We are not ready to let them.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_149A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7No mercy was shown to my
comrades in Stalingrad.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_200A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Victory is at hand! The German cowards 
desert their posts, but they have nowhere left to run!
Smash all that remains of their broken line 
and seize the train station. From this moment on...
Every step we take brings us closer to Berlin.
Closer to victory! Closer to revenge! URA!!!!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_200B_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Victory is at hand! The German cowards 
desert their posts, but they have nowhere left to run!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_200C_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7From this moment on...  
Every step we take brings us closer to Berlin.
Closer to victory! Closer to revenge! URA!!!!

SUBTITLE_SEE1_INT_014A_REZN_A_CA.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Our tanks are ready to smash this line and...

SUBTITLE_SEE1_INT_016A_CHER.en:
^1CHERNOV: ^7There is no point, Sergeant...
They are already bleeding to death.

SUBTITLE_SEE1_INT_017A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Then maybe our friend will help
them to bleed faster.

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_001A_COMM.en: ^1COMMISSAR: ^7Today we lay waste to the German line!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_003A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Good.  Now, take a closer look
at those rats on the horizon!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_004A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7They will be the first to burn this day!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_009A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Ha! The first of many, my friend!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_011A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Remember, we are vulnerable
when reloading. Make every shell count!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_013A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Destroy it!  The Panther's speed
makes it a deadly adversary!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_020A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Push forward!!!
More 88s remain, west and south of your position!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_022A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Stay on the road or push through the field!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_025A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Two more remain, over to the north!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_030A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Two more. Two more, over to the south!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_032A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7We are vulnerable to attack from all sides!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_042A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Attention, Comrades!
Push forward and obliterate the Fascist radio tower.

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_046A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Good work Dimitri, there will
be no cry for reinforcements!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_048A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Move in to destroy the fuel depot!
Cripple their military machine!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_111A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7We could be burning Germans right now!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_202A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Show them the fury they have unleashed!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_507A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7The hide of the King Tiger is strong!
FIRE AGAIN!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_530A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7If we take much more, we will burn to death!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_532A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7We will fight on to the train station...
And then, onto Berlin!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_533A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7More Panzershreck fire! Take them all out!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_534A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7There... We will prepare for the final
push to the train station.

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_535A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Enough talk. We must push
forward to the train station!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_536A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The final push before we move onto Berlin.

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_703A_COMM.en: ^1COMMISSAR: ^7The train station is within our grasp!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_704A_COMM.en:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7As our planes rain death from above,
crush their final positions!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_001A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7In Berlin, the Germans will truly
see what they have unleashed!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_004A_RUR1.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7I killed at least twenty!
Three of them with my bare hands!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_005A_RUR2.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Liar! When we were knee deep
in blood, you were crawling on your belly!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_006A_RUR2.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7You are lucky the Commissar
was not around!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_007A_RUR2.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7He would have had
you shot for cowardice!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_008A_RUR1.en:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7What about brave Chernov?
How many did you kill... Three?

SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_012A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7In the midst of all the blood,
the bullets and the dead... I found that
an old friend was still very much alive...
Dimitri Petrenko!

SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_013A_REZN_B.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7I saw this man cheat death... 
Time after time at the siege of Stalingrad.

SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_014A_REZN_B.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7As long as HE lives,
the heart of this army cannot be broken.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_003B_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Take my rifle and watch the road.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_004A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak in the car is
General Heinrich Amsel architect of Stalingrad's misery.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_005A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7He is responsible for the cold blooded 
murder of men, women and children...
Not just here, but throughout the motherland.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_006A_REZN_C.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7For three days I have hunted him. 
For three days luck alone has saved his wretched life.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_008A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Now, load your rifle, but hold your fire.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_009A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Wait until the bombers are directly overhead.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_010A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7The sound of their engines will
drown out your shot.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_011A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Sniping your enemy is like hunting
any other animal.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_012A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Fire at the wrong moment and your
chance will be forever lost.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_027A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Your reactions could be quicker,
but the job is done.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_029A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Excellent aim!  You are a natural hunter.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_030A_REZN_C.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Time to close in for the kill.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_032A_REZN_B.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Armored patrol...
We must find another route to Amsel.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_033A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7This way, before they discover their dead.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_035A_REZN_C.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7For days I have crept through
shadows like a rat.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_037A_REZN_C.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7This place once echoed
with conversations of friends and lovers.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_041A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7We will take the fight to their land... 
to their people... to their blood.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_043A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Knowing the routines and movements
of your prey tips the balance of a hunt.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_044A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7General Amsel is a creature of habit.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_045A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7He inspects each German garrison every day.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_046A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7We can use this building to flank his route.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_049A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Svoloch almost got me.
We'll have to flush him out before we move on.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_051A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The shot came from across the river!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_052A_REZN_B.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Now the game is cat and mouse.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_053A_REZN_B.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7I will draw his fire.
Keep your eyes open for the flash.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_056A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's on the fourth floor, right side!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_056B_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's on the top floor, right side!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_058A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's on the fourth floor, left side!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_058B_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's on the top floor, left side!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_060A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7I'm going to draw his fire again,
get ready to take him out...

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_064A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7I cannot risk it again...
It's up to you to find him now.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_065A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Stay out of the light.  If he fires, move.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_066A_REZN_B.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's spotted you, get over to the window!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_068A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7You need to take a different position!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_071A_REZN_B.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7The patrols will surely have
heard those shots.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_077A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7They are trying to burn us out!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_100A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Do what I say, and we can
avenge this massacre.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_101A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7My injured hand means I can no longer aim.
You will do it for me.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_102A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7If we reveal our position to Amsel's men,
this fountain will be our grave.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_104A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7You have given away our position!
Go down fighting!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_109A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Your shots tell him exactly where you are!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_205A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7You have let our chance for vengeance
slip through our fingers!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_214A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7We need to find a way out!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_301A_DALE.en:
^1DALETSKI: ^7We thought you were among the
dead in the massacre at the square!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_302A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7He was. Among them, but not one of them.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_303A_DALE.en:
^1DALETSKI: ^7We're about to assault
the communication post north of here...

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_304A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Good. Such a move will prevent
the German command calling for help.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_305A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri and I will provide cover from above...
Wait till you hear the screams of dying Germans.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_307A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Hold your fire.  Do you see the flamethrowers?

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_309A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Exploding the fuel tank will incinerate
anyone standing nearby.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_317A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Give covering fire to our comrades below!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_324A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7German reinforcements!
Moving on to the left balcony!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_326A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Our friends are moving up.
We must do the same!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_329A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Do you feel your heart beat
faster as we get closer to our prey?

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_330A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7General Amsel will soon be in our sights.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_331A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Get into position and give covering fire!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_334A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7They have taken the communication post.
Amsel will try to run.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_335A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Quickly! We must cut off his escape route!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_336A_REZN.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7Look ahead...
The building adorned with flags is the German command post...

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_340A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The sounds of battle will flush him out.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_353A_REZN_A.en:
^1REZNOV: ^7We have struck a great blow for the city...
for all of Russia.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_400A_REZN_C.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7(laughing) You are a true marksman, Dimitri!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_407A_REZN_A.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Keep firing! Our friends below need cover!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_409A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7There is nothing we can do for our comrades...

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_410A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7We are too close to our goal to reveal our position.

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_412A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Put a bullet in his bodyguard's head!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_414B_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel has moved behind the artillery piece!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_414C_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The Mudak is behind the artillery piece!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_415C_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is behind the smoking car!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_416C_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is getting into that car!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_419A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7They will be coming for us! We  must go!

SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_421A_REZN.en: ^1REZNOV: ^7Into the river, Dimitri! It is our only chance!
